description_zh: 调用DeleteUsers删除一个或多个集群用户
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc delete-users --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --user Name=user1 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteUsers

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

fields.help_en:
The name of the user N that you want to delete. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html operation to query the users of the cluster
fields.help_zh:
第N个要删除的用户名。N的取值范围：1~100

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html获取该集群中的用户名
fields.name: name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the asynchronous mode for this request.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
采用异步消息链路删除用户。

默认值：false
parameters.name: async
